name: Neapolitan Base
summary: Long cold ferment. Puffy cornicione, thin centre, leopard spots.

steps.text: Dissolve salt in the water, add flour and leaven, mix to a shaggy mass.
Rest 20 minutes then knead until smooth.
Divide into balls, box, cold ferment 24 hours.

bake.notes: Domestic oven: steel on the top rack at max heat, 6 to 7 minutes with a final broil.

notes: 62% is the sweet spot for hand stretching.
